content: npm MCP server publishing: package.json bin map (one entry per server, e.g. medium-research-hn -> servers/hn/server.js) + #!/usr/bin/env node shebang on each entry file; clients run npx -y <pkg>@latest or the installed bin. Single package with multiple bin entries is standard for suites (cf @playwright/mcp single-bin; multi-bin fine). files whitelist servers/ shared/ manifests; no build step needed for plain ESM.
